citation: Hayes et al. (2017), Tectonic Summaries of Magnitude 7 and Greater Earthquakes from 2000 to 2015, USGS Open-File Report 2016-1192
evidence_used: Event-specific tectonic interpretations for five Mariana M7+ slab events: usp0009qb4 (126.5 km normal), usp000aqsu (37.0 km shallow oblique-reverse slab), usp000b37m (85.7 km reverse slab), usp000fpca (260.0 km oblique-reverse slab), and usp000frnh (207.0 km oblique-reverse slab).
limitations_and_caveats: Covers M7+ events through 2015 only; excludes M6.5-6.9 events and post-2015 events (such as 2016 M7.7 us100068jg). Verbatim text must be confirmed prior to final freeze.

citation: Hasterok et al. (2022), New Maps of Global Geological Provinces and Tectonic Plates, Earth-Science Reviews 231, 104069
evidence_used: Surface point-in-polygon overlays (10 East Mariana Ridge, 6 Mariana Trough east; 8 Mariana Forearc, 6 Mariana Trough, 2 Mariana Volcanic Arc) and nearest mapped boundary distances.
limitations_and_caveats: Surface polygon and nearest-boundary distance are geographic descriptors only and do not establish hypocentral slab depth or focal mechanism.

citation: Bird (2003), An updated digital model of plate boundaries, Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems 4(3), 1027
evidence_used: PB2002 plate overlays assigning 12 epicenters to Mariana Plate (MA) and 4 epicenters (usp000ahx8, usp000ddgf, usp000fpca, usp000hj6r) to Philippine Sea Plate (PS); 0 inside PB2002 orogens.
limitations_and_caveats: Model discretization differs from Hasterok Mariana subplate polygons along the back-arc and southern trench/transform margin.

citation: Faccenna et al. (2018), Dynamics of the Ryukyu/Izu-Bonin-Marianas double subduction system, Tectonophysics 746, 229-238
evidence_used: Regional tectonic context for Izu-Bonin-Mariana trench/slab curvature and southern Mariana junction with Yap/Philippine Sea boundary.
limitations_and_caveats: Regional geodynamic synthesis only; does not provide event-level source mechanisms for usp000ddgf or usp000hj6r.

citation: Reagan et al. (2023), Subduction initiation as recorded in the Izu-Bonin-Mariana forearc, Earth-Science Reviews 247, 104573
evidence_used: Regional structural context distinguishing Mariana forearc, volcanic arc, and back-arc trough domains.
limitations_and_caveats: Regional structural framework only; does not establish individual earthquake source mechanisms.

citation: USGS ComCat Annual GeoJSON Archive (2000-2025) and Frozen Target Catalogue v002
evidence_used: Reconciled all 16 Mariana IDs across annual GeoJSON payloads (1,186/1,186 total catalogue match); confirmed summary types include moment-tensor (16/16) and focal-mechanism (11/16).
limitations_and_caveats: Summary types flags confirm product advertisement only; full ComCat detail product payloads have not yet been inspected.
